meta.title: Coach Matt Calls
meta.textType: story: a phone call with a name and a number

paragraphs: On Wednesday, the fourteenth of October, Lily and Pip were in the living room. It was five o'clock. The telephone rang, and Lily picked up the phone. "Hello, Lily, this is Coach Matt," said a man. "Is Tom's dad there?" "Dad is out at the moment," said Lily. "Is anyone else at home?" asked Coach Matt. "Only Pip," said Lily, "and he can't write!"

Lily took a pencil and a piece of paper. "I am at a hotel in Chiang Mai this week," said Coach Matt. "Football practice is going to move." "It is going to be on Friday, not on Thursday." "The date is the sixteenth of October, at four o'clock." "This is important, so please write it down." "My number is zero eight one, two three four, five six seven eight." Lily wrote the day on the paper.

"Woof, woof!" said Pip at the phone. "I can't hear you, Coach Matt," said Lily. "Pip, be quiet! I will play with you in a minute." "Please repeat the number," she asked. Coach Matt said it again, slowly. "Zero eight one, two three four, five six seven eight." Lily wrote the name and the number on the paper. Lily read the name and the number back to him. "That is right," said Coach Matt.

Coach Matt said, "No problem. Thank you, Lily." It was a short conversation, but it was important. "I will not forget," said Lily. Dad came home at half past five. Lily gave the paper to Dad. "Who called?" asked Dad. "Coach Matt," said Lily. "I must remember this," said Dad. He put the paper on the fridge. Pip got a biscuit.
text.summary: Coach Matt calls Tom's home from Chiang Mai. Lily writes down his name, his number, and the new day of football practice.
